generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders
The contractor/authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the Schedule-B before uploading the documents.
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
Any Modification/clarification will be published in the kppp portal. The bidders are advised to visit the portal regularly.

They should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modified by Govt. from time to time) Cess from the contractors bill under the provisions of building and other constructions worker welfare Cess Act 1996.

Successful bidders should execute the agreement within 03 days from the date of approval intimated. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for barring to participate in the tender of KBJNL.

Contractor shall bear the service tax as per the reverse charge mechanism as per Government of India Notification No 30/2012 Service Tax Dated 20-6-2012 and any modifications/charges notified by the Government of India from time to time and on date of payment.
Agency should complete the work within the stipulated tender period, if fails action will be initiated as per tender conditions.
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any Certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidder shall upload self-attested letter pad mentioning latest Communication address, land phone & mobile Phone.
Scope of work and other conditions are as mentioned in the tender documents.

Not with standing anything stated above, KBJNL reserves right to assess the bidder capability and capacity to perform the contract, if the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of KBJNL
Under no circumstances, the cost of completion of Closure work should be exceeded the tendered cost and no EFI shall be entertained.
Under no circumstances, the RA Bills are to be paid. Only first and final bill is to be processed for payment.
Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours.
All other conditions are as per Tender documents and Tender Notification
